stumbles.quote: names the Muninn `github` tool call to use instead
stumbles.why: Muninn is never explained, so a first-time reader can't tell what it is or what the `github` tool call is. The message doesn't say which call the guard suggests.
The message doesn't say what kind of session this is. It could be an agent session or a sandbox, and that matters for why the calls return 403.

point: The commit extends the guard script so it also blocks `gh api` POSTs to `/releases` and `/git/refs`, which return 403 just like `gh release create` does, and it adds tests for the new cases.
